name: Hitbox
src_typeComment: A melee attack's active hit region — its Collider stays DISABLED until Activate() (the "active frames" window of a swing), so it can't hit anything outside the animation's intended timing. Hits once per Hurtbox per Activate() call (a single swing can't multi-hit the same target), tracked via a per- activation HashSet that's cleared on the next Activate(). Unity only raises trigger callbacks for a collider pair where at least one side has a Rigidbody OR a CharacterController — the attacker this is attached to (or parented under) needs one of those for hits to actually register, unless the TARGET's Hurtbox side already has one.

src_serialized.name: knockbackForce
src_serialized.tooltip: Knockback force magnitude, applied away from this hitbox toward whatever it hits.

src_serialized.name: source
src_serialized.tooltip: GameObject considered the attacker. Defaults to this object's root if left unassigned.
